items.title: File Widerspruch against the account-clearing decision
items.quote: Den Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung richten Sie innerhalb eines Monats ab ihrer Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an die Rentenversicherung Musterküste, Kontenweg 18, 23560 Beispielbeck.
items.computation: The letter is dated (posting day) 27.08.2025, a Wednesday, and no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the document date is the posting day. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: 27.08.+4 = 31.08.2025 (a Sunday). The Rentenversicherung is a pension-insurance (Sozialversicherungs-)body, not a tax office, so under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X the deemed-delivery day is NOT moved even though it falls on a Sunday; delivery stands at 31.08.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) is counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of delivery itself is not counted, and the period ends in the following month on the day bearing the same number as the delivery day (31). September has only 30 days, so per the 'no such day' rule the period ends on the last day of September: 30.09.2025 (a Tuesday, not a weekend or NW public holiday, so no further shift is needed).
